authorization.decision: record the owner's seven selections, complete formal adoption where authorized, and evaluate the custodian appointment
authorization.instrument: the owner's written Stage 2ZK instruction of 2026-11-15
authorization.scope: docs/research/stage2zk/ only; decision records, adoption processing where procedurally valid, hashing, and Git operations; no data access; no Gate 2; no candidate substitution; no strategy design

deliverables.role: The owner's seven Stage 2ZI selections recorded as decisions: the verbatim affirmation, the seven choices, the 2ZD-4 values with qualifications, the C-N consequence, the disclosed formality limitation and cure, the preserved unresolved matters, and the status table

The amendment adoption assessed against its own section 8 requirements: the verbatim affirmation, the seven conditions quoted, the condition-by-condition result (pending), why the O-1 limitation is not carried, the exact missing owner statement, what was not done, and the effects if later adopted

The custodian appointment assessed against its own instrument: the verbatim affirmation, the instrument's requirements, the pending result, the exact missing appointment statement, and the preserved restrictions

Independent validation of the three acts and every hash: repository state, recomputed hashes, predecessor manifest verification, the completion/pending determination, the NOT VERIFIED list, and the zero-access record
What the stage was authorized to do, what it did, what each act resolves, what remains unauthorized, the unchanged gate status, and the zero-access record

findings.summary: the owner's affirmation decides the seven selections but does not satisfy the amendment's adoption form: it names no hash, carries no date, and acknowledges neither V-1 nor Y-1/Y-2
findings.treatment: adoption recorded as PENDING; the exact missing statement is prepared in STAGE2ZK_PROTOCOL_ADOPTION_RECORD.md section 5; the protocol text is left unmodified

findings.summary: the owner's acceptance of the 2ZD-4 custody recommendation is not the separate named appointment the custodian instrument requires
findings.treatment: appointment recorded as PENDING; the exact missing statement is prepared in STAGE2ZK_CUSTODIAN_APPOINTMENT_RECORD.md section 4

findings.summary: the repository convention permits the agent to assign a recording date but reserves an adoption effective date to the owner's own statement
findings.treatment: records carry the working-session date 2026-11-15 (UTC) as the recording date; the adoption effective date is left pending

findings.summary: the protocol requires semantic versions and a manifest per version but carries no version string anywhere
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; the amendment assigns 2.0.0 as a first version and the adopting statement must acknowledge it

findings.summary: the amendment cannot itself edit section 8.2, because section 10.3 forbids changing a frozen artifact before adoption
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; no protocol edit and no versioned artifact were produced

findings.summary: Stage 2ZG cites packet section 7 issue I-2 for Q-1, but the packet contains no Q-1, no I-2, and no issue list in section 7
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; Q-1 is recorded strictly as a confirmation of the 26 bp label

findings.summary: 2ZD-4 has five fields in the packet and seven in the accepted proposal, the additions being the resample count and the seed
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; disclosed as a superset

findings.summary: the 90-day embargo is derived from 540 x 4h and its agreement is exact but contingent
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; the registration should record the derivation, not the number

findings.summary: under R-b the four disclosed Stage 2ZC boundary open_time inspections are reserved contact
findings.treatment: preserved as a pre-amendment deviation; neither grandfathered nor erased

findings.summary: the Stage 2ZC full-file SHA-256 digests also touched reserved bytes and are reserved contact under R-b
findings.treatment: preserved as a pre-amendment deviation; after any adoption only the custodian may recompute them

findings.summary: protocol section 10.4 permits a pre-registered interpretation to resolve an ambiguity, so R-b is the stricter route rather than the only route
10,000 resamples and seed 20240101 appear in one prior recommendation only
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; disclosed as a comparability and reproducibility choice

findings.summary: no candidate specification contains an exit or holding rule, so dependence adequacy and embargo sufficiency stay conditional
findings.treatment: carried unchanged; an unresolved Gate 2 registration input distinct from the missing hypothesis

hashing_procedure: SHA256 over the UTF-8 canonical JSON encoding (json.dumps, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) of this object with the self_hash field removed. The file is written with indent=2, sort_keys=True and a trailing newline.
nature: Owner decision recording and adoption assessment only: one owner decision record, one protocol adoption record, one custodian appointment record, one validation report, and one authorization boundary. The seven decisions are recorded; the protocol amendment and the custodian appointment are recorded as pending. No reserved byte read, streamed, decoded, or hashed; no dataset file opened; no census, backtest, simulation, parameter fit, strategy experiment, cost or liquidity measurement, quote sampling, venue contact, order, or real-capital sizing. No predecessor document modified; no protocol or addendum text changed; no gate moved.
no_performance_claim: No expected return, profitability, achievable income, execution-feasibility, or real-capital claim is made. Both candidates remain at FEASIBILITY FAIL - INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES; no hypothesis is registered; S-1 supports no frequency or profitability claim and does not relax any feasibility threshold; 26 bp and the E-2 planning values remain unmeasured assumptions and 26 bp is not a measured Nobitex cost.
open_items: adoption of the Stage 2ZI amendment under protocol section 10.2, with a dated owner statement naming its hash and acknowledging findings V-1, Y-1, and Y-2 (pending; prepared in STAGE2ZK_PROTOCOL_ADOPTION_RECORD.md section 5)
appointment of the custodian in writing, as a separate named act (pending; prepared in STAGE2ZK_CUSTODIAN_APPOINTMENT_RECORD.md section 4)
the amended protocol text and its own manifest, which adoption must authorize (finding V-2)
a hypothesis, which C-N withholds and without which Gate 2 cannot be registered at all
a registered exit and holding policy, which becomes decisive once a hypothesis is named
an answer to T-5 on the 250 target
the planning DE and p_exec brackets at registration under E-2
whether Y-1 and Y-2 affect the admissibility of any Stage 2ZC-derived result

predecessor_manifest_verification.procedure: each predecessor manifest read, its self_hash recomputed with the same canonical procedure, and each referenced deliverable re-hashed and re-sized from current bytes

repository.working_tree_at_manifest_creation: contains only the new Stage 2ZK artifacts
